title: Accounting crossword
description: Use the clues to find the accounting words.

entries.clue: A person whose job is to work with money records and taxes.
A person who checks the accounts of a company.
A document that asks a client to pay for something.
A paper that shows you paid for something.
A written agreement between two people or companies.
All the money a company receives from sales.
The money left after you pay all the costs.
A plan for how much money you can spend.
The money you get every month for your job.
Money you pay to the government.
Money in coins and notes, not a card.
